title: 歩行者横断用押しボタン筐体
description: 面取りされた黄色の筐体、保護ベゼル、奥まった触知ボタン、取付フランジと背面接続部を備える単体の静的小道具。支柱や信号機は含みません。信号制御・電気機能・アクセシビリティ規格への適合はありません。 歩行者ピクトグラムはオリジナルの装飾形状で、規格適合マークではありません。アニメーションや実行時の動作はなく、大量配置時の性能は未計測です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A standalone static prop with chamfered yellow housing, protective bezel, recessed tactile button, mounting flange and rear connection detail. No pole or signal is included. It provides no traffic-control or electrical function and makes no accessibility-compliance claim. The pedestrian pictogram is original decorative geometry, not a standards-compliance mark. No animation or runtime behavior; performance with mass placement has not been measured. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
